legend: Let's write all the positive integer numbers one after another from 1%%ZSMJ0%% without any delimiters (i.e. as a single string). It will be the infinite sequence starting with 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536...
Your task is to print the k%%ZSMJ1%%-th digit of this sequence.
input: The first and only line contains integer k%%ZSMJ2%% (1≤k≤1012%%ZSMJ3%%) — the position to process (1%%ZSMJ4%%-based index).
output: Print the k%%ZSMJ5%%-th digit of the resulting infinite sequence.
